titulo.@es: Un relato puede empezar con el presente perfecto para presentar una experiencia sin fecha concreta. Para contar qué ocurrió durante una visita concreta, usa el pasado simple y conectores como **first, later, finally**.
titulo.@en: A story can start with the perfect present to present an experience without a specific date. To tell what happened during a specific visit, use the simple past and connectors like **first, later, finally**.

texto.@es: **I've visited York twice. Last spring, I went there with my sister.** = He visitado York dos veces. La primavera pasada fui allí con mi hermana.
texto.@en: * * I) ve visited York twice. Last spring, I went there with my sister. * * = I visited York twice. Last spring I went there with my sister.

texto.@es: **First, we arrived at the station in the morning. The journey was long, but we were excited. Later, we visited the old town. Finally, we had lunch near the river.** = Primero llegamos a la estación por la mañana. El trayecto fue largo, pero estábamos emocionados. Después visitamos el casco antiguo. Finalmente almorzamos cerca del río.
texto.@en: * * First, we arrived at the station in the morning. The journey was long, but we were excited. Later, we visited the old town. Finally, we had lunch near the river. * * = First we arrived at the station in the morning. The journey was long, but we were excited. Then we visited the old town. We finally had lunch near the river.

pregunta.@es: Which word signals the last event in the story?
pregunta.@en: When word signs the last event in the story?

explicacion.@es: It signals a following event, but not necessarily the last one.
explicacion.@en: It signs a following event, but not necessarily the last one.

pregunta.@es: Completa la frase con el pasado simple.
pregunta.@en: Complete the phrase with the simple past.

bloques.frase: First, we ___ at the station in the morning.

opciones.explicacion: The story describes a completed event last spring.
This form does not fit the specific past-time context.

explicacion.@es: Es el recorrido de un lugar a otro.
explicacion.@en: It's the journey from one place to another.

bloques.frase: When did the narrator go to York with her sister?

opciones.explicacion: The story gives a specific past time.
This says how many times the narrator has visited York.
This tells when they arrived at the station.

bloques.frase: Finally, we had lunch near the river.

traduccion.@en: We finally had lunch near the river.

explicacion.@es: «Finally» va al principio para presentar el último acontecimiento.
explicacion.@en: «Finally» goes to the beginning to present the last event.

pregunta.@es: Escribe en inglés: «El trayecto fue largo, pero estábamos emocionados.»
pregunta.@en: Write in English: «The journey was long, but we were excited.»

respuestas: The journey was long, but we were excited.

explicacion.@es: Usa el pasado simple para describir el viaje terminado.
explicacion.@en: Use the simple past to describe the finished journey.

intro.@es: Practica cómo contar una visita breve y ordenar sus acontecimientos.
intro.@en: Practice how to count a short visit and order your events.
